name: airo-doffy-key4-parallel-c8-bs32
description: Parallel batch-size-32 training of dp_beaver_key4 and dp_beaver_key4_pca on one shared GPU and twelve CPUs

command: set -Eeuo pipefail; stage_dir=/tmp/airo_key4_stage; ready_file=${stage_dir}/READY; echo 'Waiting for authenticated source/data staging...'; for stage_attempt in $(seq 1 900); do if [ -f "${ready_file}" ]; then exec bash "${stage_dir}/run-key4-sequential-cluster8.sh"; fi; sleep 2; done; echo 'Timed out waiting for staged inputs' >&2; exit 2
